units.source_text: 紫夫人连果物也不想吃，躺在床上不能起身，一连过了几天。

en.t: Lady Murasaki did not even want to eat fruit, and for several days she lay in bed unable to rise.

units.source_text: 源氏用尽心力，设法救治。

en.t: Genji devoted all his strength and tried every means to save her.

units.source_text: 他叫无数寺院举办祈祷，召唤僧人前来诵经念咒。

en.t: He had countless temples hold prayers and summoned monks to come chant sutras and spells.

units.source_text: 紫夫人所患的，不能明显指出是什么病，但觉非常难过，胸中时时乱跳，心神烦恼，不堪其苦。

en.t: It was impossible to say clearly what illness Lady Murasaki had, but she felt terribly unwell, her chest often fluttered, and her spirit was so troubled that the suffering was unbearable.

units.source_text: 做了无数佛事，一点也不曾见效。

en.t: They performed countless Buddhist rites, but not the slightest effect appeared.

units.source_text: 无论何等重病，总须渐见好转，方可令人放心。

en.t: No matter how grave an illness may be, people can only feel at ease when it gradually begins to improve.

units.source_text: 如今全不见效，源氏自然异常忧愁悲伤，无暇考虑他事，连朱雀院祝寿的筹备也停顿了。

en.t: Now that nothing worked at all, Genji was naturally overwhelmed with grief and worry, had no time to think of anything else, and even the preparations for Retired Emperor Suzaku's birthday celebration came to a halt.

units.source_text: 朱雀院闻知紫夫人病势沉重，屡次遣使前来慰问，非常殷勤。

en.t: When Retired Emperor Suzaku heard that Lady Murasaki's condition was serious, he repeatedly sent messengers to inquire after her with great concern.

units.source_text: 紫夫人的病毫无变化，直到二月尽头。

en.t: Lady Murasaki's illness showed no change at all, even through the end of the second month.

units.source_text: 源氏不堪其忧，试行迁地为良之计，将病人迁至二条院静养。

en.t: Unable to bear his anxiety, Genji tried a change of place as a remedy and moved the patient to Nijo Palace to rest quietly.

units.source_text: 六条院内全院骚动，许多人忧愁叹息。

en.t: All of Rokujo Palace was thrown into commotion, and many people grieved and sighed.

units.source_text: 冷泉院闻此消息，也很担心。

en.t: Retired Emperor Reizei heard the news and was also very worried.

units.source_text: 夕雾大将想道：“这人倘死了，父亲必然出家为僧，以遂宿愿。”

en.t: General Yugiri thought, If this lady dies, Father will surely become a monk and fulfill his long cherished wish.

units.source_text: 便尽心为病人效劳。

en.t: So he devoted himself wholeheartedly to serving the patient.

units.source_text: 祈祷诵经等事，原定的自不必说，夕雾自己又添办数堂。

en.t: The prayers, sutra recitations, and other rites already arranged went without saying, and Yugiri personally added several more services.

units.source_text: 紫夫人神志稍清时，总是恨恨地说：“不允许我出家，我好苦啊！”

en.t: Whenever Lady Murasaki's mind cleared a little, she would always say resentfully, You will not let me take vows, and I suffer so much.

units.source_text: 但源氏觉得：眼看见她自动出家而作尼僧打扮，比大限来到而和她永诀更加可惜可悲，竟是片刻也不堪能忍的。

en.t: But Genji felt that to watch her take vows of her own accord and appear dressed as a nun would be even more pitiful and heartbreaking than parting from her forever when death came, and he could not bear it for even a moment.

units.source_text: 便对紫夫人说：“早先我自己也曾矢志出家遁世，但恐留下你孤苦一人，不堪寂寞，故而迁延至今，因循度日。

en.t: He therefore said to Lady Murasaki, Long ago I myself also vowed to take religious vows and withdraw from the world, but I feared leaving you alone in lonely hardship, so I have delayed until now and merely let the days pass.

units.source_text: 如今你反倒要舍我而先去呀。”

en.t: And now you, instead, would abandon me and go first.

units.source_text: 他嘴里虽如此说，但见紫夫人的病体确是衰弱得少有复健的希望，好几次濒于危险状态。

en.t: Although he said this aloud, he saw that Lady Murasaki's sick body had truly grown so weak that there was little hope of recovery, and several times she came close to a dangerous state.

units.source_text: 因此源氏疑惑不决：是否应该允许她出家呢？

en.t: Because of this, Genji wavered in doubt over whether he ought to allow her to take vows.

units.source_text: 三公主那里几乎不曾再去。

en.t: He almost never went again to the Third Princess.

units.source_text: 对弹琴已全无兴趣，那张琴搁置一旁了。

en.t: He had completely lost interest in playing the koto, and that instrument was left set aside.

units.source_text: 六条院内的人，都集中在二条院。

en.t: The people of Rokujo Palace had all gathered at Nijo Palace.

units.source_text: 六条院内晚间灯火也很少有，住在里面的只有几个女人。

en.t: At Rokujo Palace there were very few lights even at night, and only a few women remained living inside.

units.source_text: 可见这里是全靠紫夫人一人而繁荣的。

en.t: This showed that the place had prospered entirely because of Lady Murasaki alone.
